# Galleo v1.2.1

## What's New

* **Library Compatibility & Missing Data Detection:** Galleo now automatically validates library index integrity and schema compatibility upon startup. If a library was generated by an older version, has missing metadata columns, or was left incomplete due to an unexpected system shutdown, a diagnostic compatibility alert explains the issue and offers a one-click Rescan to bring the library fully up to date.
* **High-Performance Video Similarity Engine:** Video visual similarity search and gradient sorting now use a multi-frame perceptual hashing engine with zero-heap-allocation nibble lookup tables and duration-weighted scoring, delivering lightning-fast comparisons and accurate visual clustering without false positives between clips of vastly different lengths.

## Improvements

* **Instant Video Playback & Refined Controls:** Removed click debounce delays for instantaneous play/pause response, added native double-click for fullscreen toggling, optimized video container layout during rotation, and refined scrubber thumb transitions and sans-serif timecode rendering.
* **Post-Scan Compatibility Validation:** Library health and index compatibility status are automatically re-evaluated and refreshed immediately following scan completion and background post-processing.
* **Refined Duplicate Candidate Filtering:** Exact duplicate audit and perceptual clustering now enforce strict video duration tolerance and format consistency checks to prevent mismatched media types or duration discrepancies from clustering together.
* **Grid & Timeline Layout Stability:** Optimized virtualized container sizing and section headers across `MediaGrid` and `MediaTimeline` to prevent layout jumps during library scrolling and resizing.

## Bug Fixes

* **Interrupted Scan Recovery:** Resolved an issue where interrupted scans could leave partial index metadata unflagged; the app now properly detects incomplete indexing cycles on startup and prompts for recovery.
* **Score Badge Boundary Protections:** Added safeguards to quality score hover cards and badges to prevent rendering errors when inspecting media items with partially indexed metrics.
